as_read: The label's own Capsifen at the label's daily total has one positive 24-person placebo-controlled trial whose abstract names no primary outcome; the stored study is chili pepper as food.
settling_paper: 32578488: full text would state whether a primary outcome was named and which one. It tests Capsifen 200 mg daily, which matches the daily total on label 328728, and 24 subjects remains a thin base even if a primary is named.
stop_list: Label splits 200 mg into two doses; trial gives it once daily
stored_rating_note: positive_moderate rests on a food amount of red chili pepper in a respiration chamber (PMID 23844093), reported as acute metabolic markers; the stored record does not hold PMID 32578488.
